profile.headline: Software Engineer at SAS
profile.summary: Denver, CO area software engineer with focus in aerospace.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Support client contracts through C/C++ software development, unit test development with 
GoogleTest, and software qualification test procedure development. Work as a member of an 
Agile Scrum team that utilizes the Atlassian toolset (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence, SonarQube).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for Linux embedded systems using C/C++. Used AWS and Visual Studio extensively to support software development. Helped improve software workflows through remote development tools.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: I work as part of the software group in Systems Development Division. My responsibilities include developing software design documents, implementing custom C/C++ software independently and collaboratively, and integrating hardware software components into larger electronic systems.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Computer Science and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I implement software solutions as a part of the Systems Engineering Division. The languages I primarily use are C, C++, and C#. I use the Microsoft Visual Studio and Eclipse integrated development environments depending on the target system and programming language called for in the project. I use a range of application programming interfaces and programming libraries including CUDA and OpenCV.
